title: Standing Wave Pattern
text: For a string fixed at both ends, nodes occur at both ends. The third harmonic has 3 antinodes and 4 nodes. The relationship between string length L and wavelength is: L = n(wavelength/2), which gives wavelength = 2L/n.

title: Substituting Values
text: With L = 0.65 m and n = 3 (third harmonic), substitute into wavelength = 2L/n = 2(0.65)/3 = 1.30/3 = 0.433 m.
